svg.aria-label: Code Audit: Sweeps an entire repo in nine phases, pins every finding to a file and line, ranks them Critical to Info, and hands you a fix plan in priority order.
svg.text: Sweeps an entire repo in nine phases, pins every finding
to a file and line, ranks them Critical to Info, and hands
you a fix plan in priority order.
“Findings with no remediation aren't findings, they're complaints.”
